question: Which of the following words is not mentioned in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Federalism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Federalism:-**

 
 
• It is a complex and fascinating system of government.
 
• It's like a tightrope walk, constantly trying to balance the competing needs of a unified nation with the diverse aspirations of its constituent parts.
 
• **Federalism is the only word not mentioned in the Indian Constitution.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Secular: **

 
 
• The word "secular" was added to the Preamble by the 42nd Amendment in 1976.
 
 
 
• **Socialist: **
 
 
• Though not explicitly mentioned, the principles of socialism like social justice, equality, and economic welfare are enshrined in the Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Republic: **
 
 
• India is defined as a "Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic" in the Preamble itself.
